name: safeai-inquiry-agent
description: LangGraph agent that classifies SafeAI-613 support inquiries by category and urgency, drafts RAG-grounded replies, screens them with automated guardrails, and sends only after explicit admin approval.
download_url: N/A - internal agent, not distributed as a downloadable package
tasks_capable_of_performing: Classify support inquiries by category (bug/feature/feedback) and urgency (urgent/normal/low)
Draft RAG-grounded replies using the SafeAI-613 help article knowledge base
Screen drafts for policy violations (leaked contact info, unsupported promises) before they reach an admin
Send an approved reply and mark the inquiry as handled, only after explicit admin approval
examples_of_suitable_questions: The app keeps crashing whenever I try to upload a file larger than 10MB.

The export button on the reports page doesn't do anything when I click it.
